mapper.select: SELECT rel_id AS id, plan_id AS planId, course_id AS courseId, course_category AS courseCategory, is_required AS isRequired, semester_order AS semesterOrder, gmt_create AS gmtCreate FROM edu_plan_course WHERE plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY COALESCE(semester_order, 999), course_category, course_id

SELECT pc.rel_id AS relId, pc.plan_id AS planId, pc.course_id AS courseId, c.course_name AS courseName, c.course_code AS courseCode, pc.course_category AS courseCategory, pc.is_required AS isRequired, pc.semester_order AS semesterOrder FROM edu_plan_course pc LEFT JOIN edu_course c ON pc.course_id = c.course_id WHERE pc.plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY COALESCE(pc.semester_order, 999), pc.course_category, pc.course_id
